WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE
                WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
            END) AS avg_signed_amount,
        AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_account_amount,
        AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) AS mean_region_amount
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT
    r.region,
    r.avg_account_amount,
    r.avg_account_balance,
    r.avg_account_amount / o.mean_region_amount AS ratio
FROM region_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE o.mean_region_amount IS NOT NULL;
